What the shop does

The four services the shop lists on its own Facebook page.

Tyre sales and repairs

New tyres fitted and punctures repaired. One customer writes that the team helped choose the right tyres for the car and fitted them quickly and correctly.

Wheel balancing

Wheels balanced after fitting, so the car runs smoothly at speed.

Wheel alignment

Steering and wheel alignment measured and set, so tyres wear evenly and the car drives straight.

Roadside help

Help on the road when a tyre fails away from the shop. Call ahead and describe where you are.

At the shop

Photos from the shop’s own Facebook page.

How a visit works

Taken from what customers describe in their Google reviews.

Fast work

Many reviews say fast, one says lightning fast. When a customer needed an urgent repair at closing time, the team waited for them.

Polite team

Polite and friendly staff is the point customers mention most often, together with a professional team.

A clean workshop

Customers write about a very clean, welcoming place, which one of them calls rare for a tyre shop.

Tyres for every vehicle

Nikolas Tyre Services works from a large workshop at Filippou 10 in the Kiti industrial area near Larnaca. On its Facebook page the shop names tyre sales and repairs, balancing, wheel alignment and roadside help. The photos there show cars, 4x4s and vans, but also truck tyres on the tyre changer, tractors and wheel loaders. On Google the shop has 4.9 stars from 40 reviews, and customers mention fast work, a polite team and a very clean workshop.

What customers say

Three of 40 Google reviews, 4.9 stars on average.

“I’ve been coming here for 3 years and have brought in 4 different cars — every time, the service has been outstanding. Super professional team, fast and reliable work, and what really stands out is how incredibly clean and welcoming the place is. Not something you often find at a tire shop! Always a pleasure to stop by. These guys truly know what they’re doing, highly recommend!”
